description: A tourist spot in the mountains allows visitors to travel to the top either by hot-air balloon or gondola lift. A hot air balloon can carry 4 visitors while a gondola lift can carry 6 visitors. Each hot air balloon produces 10 units of pollution while each gondola lift produces 15 units of pollution. There can be at most 10 hot-air balloon rides and at least 70 visitors need to be transported. How many of each type of transport method should be taken to minimize the total pollution produced?

VisitorsPerBalloon.definition: Number of visitors that can be carried by one hot-air balloon

VisitorsPerGondola.definition: Number of visitors that can be carried by one gondola lift

PollutionPerBalloon.definition: Units of pollution produced by one hot-air balloon ride

PollutionPerGondola.definition: Units of pollution produced by one gondola lift ride

MaxBalloonRides.definition: Maximum number of hot-air balloon rides allowed

MinVisitors.definition: Minimum number of visitors that need to be transported

objective.description: "Minimize the total pollution produced by the hot-air balloon and gondola lift rides used to transport visitors."

constraints.description: The number of hot-air balloon rides must not exceed MaxBalloonRides
The total number of visitors transported by hot-air balloons and gondola lifts must be at least MinVisitors
The number of hot-air balloon rides must be a non-negative integer
The number of gondola lift rides must be a non-negative integer
